name: psn-robotics-benchmark-data
description: A collection of robotics benchmark data intended for evaluation of robot perception and control algorithms. The dataset contains sensor logs, trajectories and task annotations used to evaluate trajectory prediction, imitation learning and related robotics tasks. It is hosted on Hugging Face for easy access and reuse by robotics researchers.
reputation: Niche dataset hosted on Hugging Face with limited but growing use in robotics research.
